mapper.select: SELECT sp.user_id, sp.id AS plan_id, sp.plan_date, COUNT(st.id) AS task_count, COALESCE(SUM(st.estimated_minutes), 0) AS estimated_minutes FROM study_plan sp JOIN study_task st ON st.plan_id = sp.id AND st.deleted = 0 AND st.status IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS') WHERE sp.plan_date = #{planDate} AND sp.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY sp.user_id, sp.id, sp.plan_date ORDER BY sp.user_id

SELECT id, user_id, title, due_at FROM study_task WHERE status IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND deleted = 0 AND due_at > #{now} AND due_at <= DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) ORDER BY due_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, user_id, title, due_at FROM study_task WHERE status IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND deleted = 0 AND due_at IS NOT NULL AND due_at < #{now} ORDER BY due_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT user_id, exam_date FROM user_study_goal WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND exam_date IS NOT NULL AND exam_date >= #{today} ORDER BY exam_date ASC, user_id ASC
